decisions.reason: As a recent launch that builds on the firm's established office offer and already received its own webpage, management is likely to continue backing it rather than quickly admit a mistake.
This chair family is close to the core business and was prominently presented, so sunk development and marketing effort support keeping it on the market.
Although somewhat more niche, it still builds on the firm's materials and interior concept and has visible public commitment through its own page, which favors persistence.
The sofa fits the established assortment, but because website commitment was weaker than for the other launches, it is somewhat more exposed if management needs to trim the range.
A high standing table is close to the firm's workplace and conference orientation, and the dedicated webpage signals enough commitment to make withdrawal unlikely after only a year.
The rug collection is more distant from the traditional offer, but the firm publicly launched it on its own page and can still justify it as part of a broader interior solutions strategy.
